description:
kith-store/src/lib.rs: the Store accessor methods return sub-store views that carry a lifetime tied to the internal rusqlite::Connection:

- pub fn chats(&self) -> chat::ChatStore<'_>
- pub fn contacts(&self) -> contact::ContactStore<'_>
- pub fn attachments(&self) -> attachment::AttachmentStore<'_>
- pub fn messages(&self) -> message::MessageStore<'_>
- pub fn outbox(&self) -> outbox::OutboxStore<'_>
- pub fn spaces(&self) -> space::SpaceStore<'_>

The lifetime parameter '<'_> binds to &self.conn (a rusqlite::Connection). This means:
1. The sub-store return types are part of the public API surface. ChatStore<'_>, ContactStore<'_> etc. are public types in their respective modules, and their lifetime parameter exposes that they borrow from a Connection internally.
2. Any refactoring that changes how Store holds its connection (e.g. switching to a connection pool, wrapping in Arc, splitting read/write connections) requires changing these return types and breaks all callers that store a sub-store in a variable.
3. The lifetime propagates into caller function signatures, forcing callers to annotate lifetimes explicitly rather than being able to treat sub-stores as owned values.

Fix: return owned sub-store objects that hold an Arc<Connection> or equivalent, removing the lifetime tie to Store. This decouples the public API from the internal storage model.
title: kith-store: Store sub-store methods return types tied to rusqlite lifetime
